description.description: A short label of what the command works on or produces: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb (shown to the user as "Ran <label>")

stdin.description: With run_in_background: keep the command's input open, so TaskInput can write to it. Only for a program that waits for input

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a task id and output file path at once. Use this instead of &; read its output with TaskOutput and stop it with TaskStop

run_outside_sandbox.description: Ask the user to run this command outside the OS sandbox. Only after the sandbox refused it, or when you know it cannot work in the sandbox
